theorem_title: Shared-bank host time fits the size-only budget
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankCosts.host_time_le {NB NC n : ℕ} (hB : NB ≤ n) (hC : NC ≤ n) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingHost.time (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingCosts.half n) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingCosts.blocks n) NB NC (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandSize n) ≤ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankCosts.budget n := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $N_B,N_C,n\in\mathbb N$ with $N_B,N_C\le n$. Specialize the shared-host microblock parameter, block count and band size to the schedule at $n$. Then

$$T_{\mathrm{sharedHost}}(h(n),J(n),N_B,N_C,g(n))\le\operatorname{budget}_{\mathrm{sharedBank}}(n).$$

This gives a uniform original-input-size bound for reusable shared reporting preprocessing.
